title: Clause-by-clause interrogatory authoring pipeline
summary: Most contracts are processed clause by clause. The next question is discovered from current examination state: explain the clause, identify affected parties/capacities, classify modality, identify triggers/conditions/exceptions/definitions/dependencies/consequences/ambiguity, then challenge proposed propositions and explicit implications such as “does X imply Z when A?”.
invariants: An answer is not acceptance: ANSWER -> REVIEW/CHALLENGE -> ACCEPT, REVISE, REJECT or REFER.
Every accepted proposition must remain traceable to the exact clause/source object and its evidence.
Implication tests distinguish supported, contradicted, partially supported, conditionally supported, unresolved and legal-review-required outcomes.
Exceptions and qualifications must be tested before an over-broad proposition can enter the active legal record.
Document-level reconciliation of definitions, precedence, amendments, survival and cross-clause conflicts is mandatory before compile handoff.

provenance.claim: Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
